spans.s:
कौक्कुट a. [कुक्कुट-अण्] Relating to
a cock.

कौक्कुटिकः [कुक्कुट-ठक्]
1 A
poulterer.
--2 A mendicant who walks always
fixing his eyes on the ground
for fear of treading upon worms,
insects &c.
--3 (Hence) A
hypocrite.

कौक्ष a. (क्षी f.)
1 Tied to, or
being on, the sides.
--2 Abdominal.

कौक्षेय (यी f.) [कुक्षि-ठञ्]
1
Being in the belly.
--2 Being in a
sheath; असिं कौक्षेयमुद्यम्य
चकारापनसं मखं

कौक्षेयकः [कुक्षौ बद्धोऽसिः ढकञ्] A
[]
sword, scimitar; बामपार्श्वावलंबिना
कौक्षेयकेण
